idea-plugin.name: Go Portable
idea-plugin.description:
Write & run Go in IntelliJ IDEA Community — for free. Go Portable adds lightweight Go support to the free IDE, with no GoLand license and no system-wide Go install required. IntelliJ IDEA Community doesn't bundle the official Go plugin (that's Ultimate / GoLand only), so this fills the gap.

  • Portable Go toolchain — download a Go toolchain from inside the IDE (like the JDK downloader), straight from go.dev/dl. Stored under ~/.go-portable; switch versions anytime.
  • Run with one click — a green ▶ gutter marker on func main(), plus right-click ▸ Run. Runs the whole package from the module root, so relative paths and .env config resolve just like GoLand — with an Environment variables field (and ENV_FILE auto-filled when a root .env exists).
  • Code intelligence (optional) — completion, go-to-definition, hover docs and error highlighting via gopls, the official Go language server, bridged with the free LSP4IJ plugin. One click installs gopls on your portable toolchain. Fully offline; no Node.js.
  • Syntax highlighting — for .go files (keywords, strings, comments, numbers), even without the language server.
  • Run go tools — go mod / go get / build / test / vet / fmt in a console.

Active on IDEs without built-in Go (IDEA Community, PyCharm, WebStorm, …). On GoLand / IDEA Ultimate the native Go support is used instead — this plugin steps aside.
